notes:
Background: Polaris Curve Analytics builds a customer insights product sold to mid-market B2B SaaS customers. Core features rely on embeddings for semantic search + a chat assistant for guided exploration. Current stack uses OpenAI API (embeddings + chat) via a homegrown abstraction layer. Team wants to migrate to Redwood Hosted initially, validate parity, then move to Dedicated for cost predictability and data isolation.

Technical requirements / constraints:
- Workloads: high-accuracy embeddings for vector search (~500k vectors per customer), conversational chat for support flows. Also reranking pipeline for search results.
- Latency SLOs: chat p95 target ~120ms (interactive), embeddings batch throughput target ~200-400 qps for nightly ingestion.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high — aim to reduce per-token cost and caching/batching opportunities; will consider Dedicated if >30% cost savings vs current vendor.
- Model preferences: open to community/Redwood-verified models (Llama family variants / mixed quantized variants) if quality parity maintained. Need controls for quantization and rollout testing.
- Routing/fallbacks: need automatic fallback to smaller model under capacity constraints; canary rollouts for prompt changes.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, SOC2, audit logging, KMS for key management, and EU data residency for some customers.

Migration asks raised on calls:
- "We need exact parity for our NLU scoring — regressions break product metrics." — Anika Rao, Head of ML.
- Request for an OpenAI-compat adapter (same endpoint semantics) to shorten integration work. SE notes: adapter possible at SDK level; need mapping for streaming tokens and function-calling edge cases.
- Prompt parity plan: run side-by-side A/B tests on 3 canonical prompt suites (search rerank + agent prompt + summarization) and evaluate on established eval sets.
- Regressions: define acceptance criteria (delta < 2% on NLU score / rerank MRR uplift). If regressions seen, plan for prompt engineering / model selection changes.

POC plan (agreed):
- 2-week Hosted POC: run 3 parity suites, ingest 50k test vectors, run nightly batch and online queries. Measure latency, quality (rerank NDCG), and cost per 1M tokens.
- Deliverables: parity report, sample prompts + rollout suggestions, Dedicated sizing + pricing sheet.

Commercial notes:
- Polaris is mid-market, comfortable with an annual committed model for Dedicated if unit economics justify it. Estimated ARR range provided above; preliminary ask to present 3 pricing tiers: small, mid, large Dedicated pools.

Action items (short):
- SE Maya: provide technical adapter checklist and SDK snippets (due 2026-03-05).
- AE Riley: deliver Dedicated pricing scenarios and commitment discounts (due 2026-03-12).
- Security: confirm EU residency options & KMS integration (deliver by 2026-03-01).
- Customer: run internal eval of parity tests during POC window and provide verdict.

Short-fragments / CRM shorthand: ongoing, choppy notes; customer wants low lift integration, minimal prompt churn. Has existing internal prompts & eval harness. POC will be gated on regressions threshold. If passes, procurement moves quickly to 12mo Dedicated commit.
